name: AI Internship Office
summary: Evidence-based internship research, independent fit reviews, truthful application preparation and persistent progress records.

workflow.name: Evidence intake
workflow.description: Normalize sources, deduplicate opportunities and preserve candidate facts and eligibility gaps.

workflow.name: Independent council
workflow.description: Five distinct reviewers evaluate a frozen evidence packet, challenge one another and record their actual final votes.

workflow.name: Application preparation
workflow.description: Reuse confirmed answers and exact materials, checkpoint preparation and keep destination permissions tied to the application.

workflow.name: Records and world
workflow.description: Persist application stages and employer confirmations; render selectable crew workflows and separate budgeted conversations.

name: Finance Interview App
summary: Six technical interview questions with typed or dictated answers, structured follow-ups and rubric-based feedback in the local prototype.

workflow.name: Question sequence
workflow.description: Present the fixed six-question pilot sequence and the associated follow-up options.

workflow.name: Answers and follow-ups
workflow.description: Collect candidate answers. Browser speech recognition can supply dictated text; the configured model may select follow-ups.

workflow.name: Rubric and scores
workflow.description: Use the answer guide for feedback; validate score ranges and compute totals. Grading requires a configured API key and is not validated against human graders.

workflow.name: Practice preview
workflow.description: The public demo demonstrates the question flow with AI processing and external actions disabled.

name: edity · AI Video Editor
summary: An editing desk for footage, narration, creative briefs, synchronized captions, screen demonstrations, animation and export review.

workflow.name: Inspect and transcribe
workflow.description: Inspect media streams and reuse cached word timing and transcript intermediates.

workflow.name: Editorial decisions
workflow.description: Plan complete speech cuts, demonstrations and scene timing using the approved editing style.

workflow.name: Compose and animate
workflow.description: Map captions through the cut timeline, place demonstrations and use original Remotion animation examples when needed.

workflow.name: Review and export
workflow.description: Show progress and representative previews, export MP4 and verify streams and timing. Actual rendering remains in the separate editing app.

name: Accounting Outreach Desk
summary: Public firm research, named decision makers, verified business emails, exact draft approvals and reply handling for accounting-firm outreach.

workflow.name: Firm evidence
workflow.description: Bound public-page research, respect source limits and preserve evidence about named decision makers.

workflow.name: Email verification
workflow.description: Find and verify business-email candidates through configured providers; unresolved or ambiguous records stay unresolved.

workflow.name: Draft and approve
workflow.description: Bind approval to the exact recipient, message and attachment. Sender identity and postal-address setup are required.

workflow.name: Send and reconcile
workflow.description: Send only authorized drafts within limits and permitted hours, record receipts and stop follow-ups for replies and opt-outs. Sending defaults off.
